warning_texts: questions_are_answered.R04 in gate_claims_machine compares only the three counts in R04 with the metrics registry and passed an answer whose rule labels are swapped; nothing deterministic checks which exclusion rule each count is attributed to, which is what R04 asks.

The metrics registry names the period '2025-Q1-delivered' while audit_spec.yaml pins its end at 2025-03-30, one day before the calendar quarter ends; the export has no rows dated 2025-03-31, so no published figure changes, but a reader of 'Q1' would assume 31 March is included.

CLM-REFUND-RATE counts a paying customer as refunded when any delivered order has refund_amount > 0, including partial refunds (for example 13.08 on a 26.15 order); the caveats say the denominator is paying customers but do not say that a partial refund counts the whole customer as refunded.

The alternative reading of refund rate on order rows would be 33/174 = 0.189655, against the published 27/57 = 0.473684 on paying customers; the published figure follows the spec ruling, but the two readings differ by about 2.5 times, so the basis has to stay printed next to the number in the releas
summary: All five claims recompute exactly from raw_data/orders.csv (net 35741.52, refund rate 27/57 = 0.473684 on paying customers, PL 11181.67, DE 11032.61, CZ 13527.24; country parts sum to the headline) and the row accounting 201 = 174 + 26 + 1 holds.
